affected.note: Up to 186,704 email addresses of members registered by 2022-08-19. Names, birthdates, addresses, phone numbers, passwords and order history were not leaked. The attacked server was managed by a contractor.

summary.en: Art supply and stationery retailer Sekaido said a server for its online shop, managed by a contractor, was accessed through a vulnerability on 2022-08-19. Up to 186,704 member email addresses may have been leaked.
summary.ja: 画材や文具を販売する世界堂は、委託先が管理する「世界堂オンラインショップ」のサーバが2022年8月19日に脆弱性を突く不正アクセスを受けたと公表した。会員のメールアドレス最大18万6,704件が流出した可能性がある。

sources.title: 不正アクセスでECサイト会員のメアドが流出 - 文具画材店
